author: CSteele
description: Honeywell Total Connect Comfort WiFi(cloud) Thermostat Driver
releaseNotes:
v2.0.22  Retry one transient status GET or command POST after 60 seconds while retaining the existing TCC session. Only explicit authentication rejection can discard the session and trigger a login. Log caught status-response details at debug level so expected Honeywell timeouts do not create red error-log entries.
         Add selectable Debug logging time.
         Mask Honeywell Device IDs in driver-owned diagnostics while retaining the full values in preferences, Parent state, and HTTP requests.
         Isolate command accumulation, immutable in-flight delivery, bounded retries, retained failures, and acknowledgements per thermostat child and command ID.
         Give every child refresh a generation so newer manual or scheduled refreshes invalidate stale callbacks and queued retries without affecting other children.
         Correct the legacy humidifier parser's CancelMin response-line type and identify its setpoint, upper-limit, and lower-limit events accurately.
